This challenge is reserved for seasoned adventurers who possess the courage, skill, and determination to rise above the ordinary.
The foes you encounter are significantly more formidable, wielding powerful new passives and devastating Legendary Actions. Victory will demand strategy, perseverance, and the resolve to overcome even the most daunting of odds.
Those who emerge triumphant will be forever enshrined within the Hall of Heroes, where all who follow may bear witness to their achievement.
Should you conquer HomeBrew upon this difficulty, contact me (HaVeNII7) to claim your rightful place among the honoured.
May your courage never falter, and your deeds be remembered for generations to come.
Good luck, hero. Your legend awaits.

Let the annals of Faerûn forever bear witness to the extraordinary adventurers whose names are recorded here.
Through courage, cunning, and unwavering determination, these champions have overcome the trials set before them and emerged victorious. Their deeds have earned them a place of honour among the greatest heroes to walk these lands.
To each of you, congratulations. Your triumphs shall not be forgotten, and your names shall stand as an inspiration to all who dare follow in your footsteps.
Honoured Adventurers: - Captain Swampass - drivaNce - Death - Second-Mate Assburn - Urha ★ - Vee, Chaotic Pontiff of Gremlin Energy - Moorzaube - Mirenna - Gumbych - Steelplayer36 - Greed - Bananella XXIII - Mako - Annoynamous72z - Kaiser Karry, Champion of Lightning - Neem - bleah11 - YOU - Ani - The Fungus Is Amongus - Sir Pretzel - Rin - Moorzaube, Explicator of Stuns - sillyhappybone - vala - Moorzaube - IN - Rusty - 究极爆炸吕小鱼 - LincWind - Kaurll - Gemde- LincWind - Ric - TheBigB - Meop - Nighthoundz - Mysh - Chickenman - Facy - Wormiq

Beyond the trials of ordinary heroes lies the Deific Pantheon - a challenge reserved for those who would dare stand among legends.
Only the most exceptional adventurers should undertake this journey. The foes you face possess unparalleled strength, devastating new passives, and formidable Legendary Actions. The merciless mechanics of Mythic difficulty will test your abilities at every turn, and the consequences of every decision weighs both heavy and permanent. No past save may undo your mistakes, and should your entire party fall in battle, your journey will end in defeat.
Yet for those who overcome these impossible odds, you secure your place among the legends of Faerûn.
Those who conquer HomeBrew upon this difficulty shall have their names forever enshrined within the Deific Pantheon, where all who follow may bear witness to their extraordinary achievement. Upon claiming victory, contact me (HaVeNII7) to secure your rightful place among the gods.
May fortune favour the bold, may your deeds prove worthy of remembrance, and may the dice ever roll in your favour.
The Pantheon awaits.

Here stands the names of those who have accomplished what others dared not dream.
These are no ordinary champions, but legends whose courage, mastery, and unyielding resolve carried them through the greatest trials Faerûn could muster. Against overwhelming odds, they stood defiant. Where countless others fell, they endured. And through their triumph, they earned a place among the immortals.
Let their names be celebrated for all ages, their victories remembered throughout the realms, and their deeds serve as an eternal testament to what can be achieved by those who refuse to yield.
Only...
No adventurer has yet earned a place within the Pantheon. Its thrones remain vacant, awaiting the first to prove themselves worthy.
A ruthless adventure emphasizing consequence. Death comes with irreversable debilitation. Fine tune difficulty via "Adjust Difficulty" below.
